changes: Initial development release of Oscilloscope Studio
Added the basic cross-platform PySide6 application structure
Added launchers for Linux, macOS, and Windows
Added automatic uv, Python 3.12, and dependency setup
Added application restart and quit keyboard shortcuts
Added the Oscilloscope Studio application icon
Added uncaught exception, warning, stdout, and stderr logging
Added searchable in-app HTML help documentation
Added contextual help buttons and theme-aware components
Added automatic update checks through GitHub Releases
Added secure update installation with SHA-256 verification
Added release notes and version information dialogs
Added automated semantic versioning, release packaging, and GitHub publishing
Added centralized application metadata and filesystem paths
Added project setup and execution documentation
